entities.name: Query thymidylate synthase
observations: 279 aa bacterial protein; calculated molecular mass 32.66 kDa and theoretical pI 6.72.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Streptococcus pyogenes thymidylate synthase entries P67051, P0DG66, and P0DG67.
Contains Pfam Thymidylat_synt domain PF00303.25 spanning residues 7–278.
Curated homolog annotations indicate cytosolic homodimeric thymidylate synthase, EC 2.1.1.45.
Reference homolog active-site nucleophile is residue 154; query residue 154 is cysteine, consistent with thymidylate synthase catalysis.

entities.name: Thymidylate synthase reaction
observations: Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:12104 and EC 2.1.1.45.

entities.name: dTMP biosynthesis
observations: Thymidylate synthase supplies dTMP for de novo pyrimidine metabolism and downstream dTTP biosynthesis required for DNA synthesis.

entities.name: 5,10-Methylene-THF
observations: Acts as the one-carbon methyl donor and reductant in the thymidylate synthase reaction; converted to dihydrofolate.
